authorization: User explicitly authorized on 2026-10-28: preregister first, retain 5% key cross terms, compare against random and magnitude selection, examine the known step-1 versus step-255 failure, and write a plain-language report.
question: In the existing D2 development conditions, can a fixed maximum-log-time-change ranking retain at most 5% of active spectral pairs and meet the preregistered stopping-time and regret criteria?
domain: All 3240 conditions and the highlighted failure have already been inspected. This is development compression, not unseen data, a training intervention, a necessity proof, or a train-only method.

selection.pairs: All i<j pairs of active eigenmodes under the original null threshold, lexicographic order. M=r(r-1)/2, K=(5*M)//100. Keep K even when zero; do not exclude zero-weight pairs from M or round up. Record rank,M,K,K/M.
selection.score_grid: Unique sorted integer steps 0..16 plus rounded 128 geomspace points from 17 to 262144; this is for ranking only, not minimum search.
selection.change05: Cij(t)=2*hij*fi(t)*fj(t). Score=max over score grid abs((t+1)*2*hij*(fi_prime*fj+fi*fj_prime)). fi_prime=-log(qi)*qi**t/lambda_i is derivative with respect to step t, not U. Largest K scores; stable ties use pair order.
selection.magnitude05: Largest K absolute Cij(262144). Each individual |Cij| is monotone under the inherited positive GD factors, so this is the maximum amplitude over the window. Same tie rule.
selection.random05: Ten masks, labels random05_00 through random05_09, each K distinct pair indices uniformly sampled without replacement. RNG seed is integer from the first 8 SHA256 bytes of study|data_relative_path|task|replicate. Sort selected indices. Do not use Python hash or choose the best replicate.
selection.reuse: One mask per task/draw/method, shared across all nine noise levels. Scores and masks never read saved t_star or evaluate stopping quality. Keep coefficients unchanged; only h off-diagonals are masked. Diagonal, linear, val_y2, noise response remain unchanged.
selection.basis: Use original numpy.linalg.eigh convention; save eigenvalues, eigenvectors, active mask and hashes for each draw. Flag min adjacent active spacing/max eigenvalue <=1e-10. Do not rotate, drop, or regroup near-degenerate modes after seeing results.
selection.information: Scores use clean targets and validation geometry and inspect all pairs. This tests retained representation size, not data availability or computational speedup.

search: Use the previous registered dense INTEGER grid 0..256 plus rounded 4096 geomspace points 257..262144, then the same select_integer bounded local refinement preserving coarse best and bracket endpoints. No saved fractional half-time points; no claim of exhaustive extrema. References reuse saved full t_star and saved diagonal predictions without refitting.

primary_rules.time: For EACH recipe, >=80% of original interior conditions have selected time/reference in [0.5,2]. Zero predictions on positive references fail. Reference boundary cases are outside time-ratio denominator but retained in other metrics.
primary_rules.risk: For EACH recipe, >=90% of ALL conditions have (full risk at selected time - saved minimum risk)/R0 <=0.01.
primary_rules.overall: All 12 recipes must pass both. Pooled average cannot substitute. magnitude/random are equal-budget controls, not replacements for a failed primary rule.
primary_rules.random_reporting: Report all ten separate replicate outcomes and their median/min/max; do not pool them as independent data or select a best mask.
primary_rules.case: Known failure: d1_biased/sine/n32/seed6103/sigma2=1, original optimum t=255 and prior diagonal t=1. Call stopping repaired only if both time within2 and regret/R0<=0.01. Show all ten random outcomes and separate risk-only improvement; success here does not prove cross-condition validity.

validity: Never clip sparse bias or risk. Separately flag min bias and min total on dense grid plus selected point below -1e-10*max(1,R0). Stopping quality and physical risk-model validity are separate, including in highlighted case.
verification: Before computation recheck all 3528 D2 manifest files, the 3360 payload receipt pins, and all prior-run result-manifest hashes. Reconstruct full bias/noise on the common grid for all 360 task/draws and compare all 3240 saved curves within 1e-8*max(1,R0). Check original minimum and independently evaluate feature-space risk at selected times for the eight previous n64 seed6101 sigma2=1 gate conditions for all 12 methods. Check masked-matrix versus explicit selected-pair sums at steps 0/1/16/255/262144 for every mask; tolerance 1e-8*max(1,R0). Any nonfinite, mask budget error, source drift or real negative regret stops execution.
reference_regret: Evaluate full risk at candidate times directly. Preserve raw regret; values below -1e-8*max(1,R0) trigger search-discrepancy stop. Only smaller negative roundoff becomes zero in nonnegative summaries.
uncertainty: Only three master data seeds; report per-recipe, per-seed, recipe-by-seed, worst risk and >10% R0 harm counts. Ten random masks measure selection randomness, not ten additional data samples. Preserve low-rank zero budgets, all boundaries and near-degenerate cases.
secondary: Known-case full and sparse curves, arithmetic breakdown at t=1,t=255 and selected times, signed full/retained/omitted cross sums; primary versus magnitude mask overlap and score relation as descriptive checks; no post-result mask adjustment.
failure_handling: Preserve partial output; do not overwrite or adjust score, budget, thresholds, random seeds or basis after observing outcomes. Report incomplete on a gate/budget failure. Code bugs require an explicit recorded amendment before any resumed calculation.
publication: New outputs only in external AIQ_KB_DATA_ROOT/runs. Source, preregistration and result pointers only committed in this repo. Do not modify historical studies, publisher, homepage, benchmark, solver or remote processes.
